name: Amanda Goldsmith
bio: Amanda Goldsmith is an International American actress and model originally from Seattle, Washington. She studied drama at Hofstra University and has since gone on to work all over Europe. She recently made her international film debut in the Spanish-Argentine comedy Official Competition (2021). Having lived many years abroad Amanda speaks fluent Spanish and has an A1 level of Dutch.

credits.title: The Sleeping Woman
credits.overview: Ana, a nursing assistant, begins to feel attracted to Agustín, the husband of the woman in a vegetative state that she has been hired to take care of. Soon she begins to be harassed by strange paranormal phenomena that seem to try to throw her out of the house and separate her from Agustín.
